newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-STIANSEN WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-STIANSEN WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.

text.p: Tom Stiansen of Norway held off a late charge by Thomas Sykora of Austria to win the second men's World Cup slalom of the season Sunday.
A surprise leader after the first run, Stiansen skied solidly to post a time of 1:45.49. Sykora, sixth after the morning run, rallied to take second place with 1:45.65.

Another Austrian, Thomas Stangassinger, took third with 1:45.89. Kjetil Andre Aamodt of Norway was fourth in 1:45.47 and Michael Tritscher of Austria fifth in 1:46.81, according to unofficial results.
Christian Mayer of Austria, second after the first run, failed to finish the second leg. Fredrik Nyberg of Sweden, who won Saturday's giant slalom, also abandoned the course on the second run.
